posts.text: Okay. But maybe the bigger problem with Candace Owens isn’t primarily that she’s an obnoxious diva — hardly uncommon among people who care about being “celebrities.” Perhaps the bigger issue is she’s a lunatic bigot, cruel and vicious conspiracy peddler, and a profoundly ignorant hustler. But, yes, I’m sure she’s also rude to colleagues and staff, too. I also hear that Graham Platner doesn’t pick up his socks.
posts.summary: Criticizes Candace Owens as bigoted conspiracy peddler and ignorant hustler
